scope: Why the experimental v8 independent-consumer host fails during MainWindow.InitializeComponent
controlledComparison: The same malformed v8 host also exits with XamlParseException after its Orchard DLL is temporarily replaced by the v7 DLL; original v8 bytes were restored and checked by SHA-256
sdkSelfContainedRebuild: A zero-warning, zero-error build with WindowsAppSDKSelfContained=true and the same custom OutputPath retained the malformed PRI keys and the same runtime failure

correctedDefaultPathBuild.source: An independent copy of tests/PackageConsumer restored Gaulatti.Orchard 0.1.0-components-v8-local from the local NuGet feed
correctedDefaultPathBuild.procedure: Build without custom OutputPath, then Rebuild to replace the stale obj/embed resource names; framework-dependent .NET and Windows App SDK with installed 2.5.1 runtime

conclusion: The custom-path experimental host had stale, wrongly named XBF resources. A default-path Rebuild corrected its PRI, and the exact-v8-package independent x64 consumer passed its full native check and displayed a populated window. Clean-cache restore, self-contained delivery, native ARM64 runtime and complete library acceptance remain open.
